long_biography.plain_text:
Wilhelm Beier entered pharmaceuticals early in his career, holding several industry posts before managing the German subsidiaries of an international drugmaker. A decade of operating experience preceded Dermapharm. He established the company in 1991 and developed a broad portfolio of branded medicines directed at selected therapeutic fields.

Dermapharm combined internal product development and production with quality control, logistics and its own trained sales force. Expansion added healthcare products such as supplements, herbal medicines and medical devices while retaining European manufacturing. Beier moved from chief executive to supervisory-board chair in 2017. His family holding remained the majority shareholder, giving the founder an enduring role in ownership and oversight.
